objective: Expose complete email delivery and link sharing as the Skill's primary intents, with a deterministic mobile-friendly HTML email notification.
acceptance: Email intent routes validated inputs through encrypted remote delivery and then one-recipient SMTP; sharing returns URL, archive password, size and expiry without sending mail. Existing operation keys and unknown/no-resend behavior are preserved.

Core email has multipart/alternative UTF-8 plain text and deterministic HTML. HTML contains a download button, fallback URL, archive password, size and readable timezone-explicit expiry. Inline styles and fluid table layout support narrow screens, without scripts, external images or trackers.

All dynamic HTML text and attributes are escaped. Preview/test artifacts contain only synthetic data; real secrets remain confined to the existing protected handoff/password files and intended delivery message.
Project and installed Codex Skill agree on intent routing. Missing SMTP configuration blocks email before uploading a new file; ask for configuration path, never raw credentials.

Validate MIME roundtrip, HTML content/escaping, unchanged notification idempotency and unknown recovery, and visual desktop/mobile preview. Record external SMTP acceptance as pending; no actual upload or email in this implementation task.
preferences: A system notification style, not a full web sharing portal. Password means AES archive password; no browser extraction-code gate is claimed.
compatibility: FD-005 required a fixed text message. HTML multipart is an additive new requirement; its one frozen test assuming message.get_content() at the top level will be recorded as superseded, not rewritten or relabeled as an old acceptance failure. Plain-part contents and previous privacy/recovery assertions remain covered.
